nom: Stick Couvrant Pate Grise Payot - Purifying Concealer with Shale Extract - 0.056 Ounces - 1.6 grams - Made in France

avis.texte: This is an old and reputable French brand of facial products. Not a make up brand. I grew up in France and my mom used to buy this to cover up acne. It’s is not make up so it actually helps clear acne instead of making it worse. It is very subtle. The stick is tiny but it doesn’t take much. You only cover the actual pimple, don’t put it over your whole face. You can also buy the “pâte grise” from the same brand. The jar is ridiculously tiny for the price but it does work pretty good. And again, my mom used to buy it for me, so I’m buying it for my daughter.

I love this concealer but I wish it came in other shades ! I’m fairly pale so this is a shade or two too dark but I still use it. I apply this on active acne and then use my regular concealer on top and it works amazing especially if I use the spot treatment in this line I’ve had pimples disappear in a day
Works very well! I keep one in my purse and one in my makeup bag. It blends well and I like that it has Pate Grise in it to help heal blemishes.
A good concealer that helps heal blemishes while concealing. Very happy with the purchase.
I’m very happy with this as it covers nicely while protecting my delicate eye area
Absolutely fabulous for covering and healing minor blemishes.

avis.titre: Didn't blend in with my skin tone
avis.texte: Use all the Payot products very good skin products especially for troubled skin but this concealer I can't use the colour a very strange tint to it may suit other complections ?

Se lo compró a mí hija de 12 años para los granitos, le reseca el grano y se lo disimula. Yo ya lo utilizaba hace años me encanta la marca payot. La única pega que le pondría que cada vez me cuesta más de encontrar el producto y lo han subido muchísimo de precio.
Ich hab lange nach einem Abdeckstift von Payot gesucht.. Hatte ich früher jahrelang. Die Farbe passt sich gut an, deckend, und die Pickel heilen schneller...

Ma fille qui a un peu d acné adore ce produit qui camoufle les petits boutons sous forme de sticks elle peut l emmener partout. C est de la pâte grise de Payot un produit que j avais moi-même étant jeune et qui fonctionne toujours aussi bien. Merci Payot pour ce produit qui traverse les âges !!
